workouts.notes: Felt strong, good bar path on top sets.
Full dead hang stretch each rep.
Solid spinal brace, no lower back fatigue.
Hit depth parallel on every set.

exercises.name: Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench with eyes directly under the bar.
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with wrists straight.
Unrack bar, lower smoothly to mid-chest touching lightly.
Press bar up explosively locking arms without hyperextending elbows.
exercises.benefits: Builds upper body pushing power, pectoral thickness, and tricep strength.

exercises.name: Push Ups
instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart on the floor with fingers spread.
Keep core tight, body forming a straight line from neck to heels.
Lower chest until 2 inches above the ground.
Push forcefully back to the starting plank position.
exercises.benefits: Develops pectoral endurance, shoulder stability, and abdominal core tension.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set bench angle to 30 to 45 degrees.
Lower dumbbells with control toward the upper clavicular chest.
Drive weights upward in a smooth arc until nearly touching.
exercises.benefits: Emphasizes upper chest fibers (clavicular head) and anterior deltoids.
commonMistakes: Setting bench angle too steep (>45 deg shifts to shoulders)

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on flat bench holding dumbbells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Open arms out in wide hug motion feeling deep chest stretch.
Contract chest muscles to bring dumbbells back together.
exercises.benefits: Provides deep pectoral stretch and muscle hypertrophy through tension.

exercises.name: Pull Ups
instructions: Hang with overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Depress scapulae downward and pull elbows towards ribs.
Pull until chin clears the top of the bar.
Lower with steady control to full dead hang.
exercises.benefits: Widest back lats, bicep grip endurance, and vertical pulling strength.

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over mid-foot.
Hinge hips back, grasp bar just outside shins.
Brace core, flatten spine, pull slack out of bar.
Drive through floor, extending hips and knees simultaneously to lockout.
exercises.benefits: Ultimate posterior chain builder: erector spinae, lats, glutes, and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit securely with thighs under pads, grip wide angled bar.
Lean back 10 degrees and pull bar down to upper collarbone.
Squeeze lats firmly, then slowly return bar to top position.
exercises.benefits: Controlled latissimus dorsi activation and upper back broadening.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with knees slightly bent, feet on footplates.
Pull handle into lower abdomen while squeezing shoulder blades together.
Extend arms forward maintaining an upright neutral spine.
exercises.benefits: Thickens middle back (rhomboids, traps) and improves posture.
commonMistakes: Excessive forward rounding of lumbar spine

exercises.name: Overhead Shoulder Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at ear height with palms forward or neutral.
Press weights directly overhead until arms are extended.
Lower slowly under control to ear level.
exercises.benefits: Builds broad 3D deltoids, clavicular stability, and lockout power.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back into an incline press

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding light dumbbells at sides with slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out to sides until parallel to the floor.
Lead with elbows, pause 1 second at apex, and lower slowly.
exercises.benefits: Isolates lateral deltoids to create the sought-after V-taper frame.
commonMistakes: Using heavy weights and swinging hips
Raising above parallel putting impingement on joint

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward.
Curl weights upward while supinating wrists (palms up).
Squeeze biceps hard at top without swinging elbows forward.
exercises.benefits: Increases bicep peak and forearm flexor strength.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Curl dumbbells up to shoulder height maintaining vertical palms.
Lower smoothly back to starting position.
exercises.benefits: Targets brachialis and brachioradialis for forearm and arm thickness.
commonMistakes: Moving upper arms away from sides

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.equipment: Cable Machine, Rope or Straight Bar
instructions: Attach rope or bar to high cable pulley.
Pin elbows tightly to your sides and push downwards.
Spread rope ends apart at bottom for complete tricep contraction.
exercises.benefits: Builds lateral and medial tricep heads, making up 60% of upper arm mass.
commonMistakes: Letting elbows wander back and forth
Using body weight to lean over bar

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold dumbbell with both hands overhead with elbows pointing forward.
Lower weight behind head until forearms pass 90 degrees.
Extend elbows back up to full vertical stretch.
exercises.benefits: Maximizes stretch on long head of triceps for upper arm volume.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Rest bar across upper traps, feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out.
Brace core, push hips back and knees out in line with toes.
Descend until thighs are parallel or below parallel to floor.
Drive through mid-foot and heel to return upright.
exercises.benefits: King of leg builders: quadriceps, glutes, adductors, and core power.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Step forward with one foot, lowering hips until both knees bend at 90 degrees.
Keep front knee tracking over ankle and torso upright.
Push through front heel to step directly into the next lunge.
exercises.benefits: Single-leg strength, balance, glute activation, and hamstring tone.
commonMistakes: Front knee shooting past toes excessively

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit with back and head firmly against padded support, feet shoulder-width on sled.
Release safety bars, lower sled until knees reach 90 degrees.
Press through whole foot back to start without locking knees.
exercises.benefits: Heavy quadricep and glute stimulation with zero spinal loading.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunches
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat on floor.
Place fingertips behind ears, curl shoulders toward pelvis.
Contract rectus abdominis tightly at peak, lower back down with control.
exercises.benefits: Strengthens upper abdominal wall and enhances core flexion.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Rest on forearms with elbows directly under shoulders.
Keep body rigid in a straight plank line from shoulders to ankles.
Squeeze glutes, tighten abs, and breathe steadily without dropping pelvis.
exercises.benefits: Anti-extension core stability and deep transverse abdominis endurance.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in top push-up plank position.
Drive one knee forward into chest quickly, then switch legs in rhythmic running cadence.
Maintain level hips and tight core throughout.
exercises.benefits: Dynamic core conditioning, hip flexor endurance, and cardio calorie burn.

exercises.name: Treadmill / Outdoor Running
instructions: Maintain upright posture with slight forward lean from ankles.
Strike ground lightly with midfoot beneath center of gravity.
Keep arms swinging forward and back at 90 degree bends.
exercises.benefits: Cardiovascular heart conditioning, high calorie oxidation, and mental stamina.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand tall with feet together, arms by sides.
Jump feet out while clapping hands overhead.
Immediately jump back to starting position in a quick rhythm.
exercises.benefits: Full body aerobic warm-up and lymphatic circulation.
commonMistakes: Landing heavily on flat feet instead of balls of feet
